description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Persuade vs Riddle against any number of creatures within short range. On each win, the creature is affected by this spell. Your roll result becomes the Difficulty.

On each of your turns, you may spend a bonus action to choose a direction. Each affected creature must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take actions before, after or as it moves. After moving in this way, it can roll Riddle against the Difficulty to attempt to end the effect.

Affected creatures cannot be compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, but do provoke opportunity attacks as they move.

Describe the forced movement.
name: Compulsion
